C-LAND-AGENT-TOOLING-FROM-BRANCH.IntentSummary: Rescue the agent tooling stranded on chore/agent-config-and-theme onto main — the Dart MCP registration and the flutter-run skill adapted for every harness in use — and only then delete the branch.

MustPassCommand.Command: grep -q 'Live app inspection' AGENTS.md && grep -q 'Live app inspection' CLAUDE.md && diff -q AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md
test -z "$(git branch --list chore/agent-config-and-theme)" && test -z "$(git ls-remote --heads origin chore/agent-config-and-theme)"

T-001.Title: Register the Dart MCP server for the repository and opt Claude Code into it

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: .mcp.json exists at the root and declares a dart server whose command runs `dart mcp-server` with no environment overrides.
.claude/settings.json keeps its existing enabledPlugins key and gains enabledMcpjsonServers with "dart".

Verification.Command: python3 -c 'import json;d=json.load(open(".claude/settings.json"));assert "dart" in d["enabledMcpjsonServers"] and "enabledPlugins" in d'

T-002.Title: Write the flutter-run skill where this repository's sessions read skills

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: .agents/skills/flutter-run/SKILL.md carries frontmatter with name: flutter-run and a description that says when to use it.

Every piece of operational knowledge from the branch survives: the SIGUSR1/SIGUSR2 CLI loop, the JSON-RPC probe of the server, the 21-tool inventory, the traps (plain path rather than file://, boot devices first, pass udid, hot reload resets scroll and navigation, swipe from a card registers as a tap, python3 -u for buffered output) and the app layout knowledge (the floating nav bar needs about 110 pt of bottom padding, DailyRacesDisplay is a content block, cards carry no fixed size and take their shape from kDailyRaceCardAspectRatio).
The routes are named per harness with the plain-CLI path as the universal floor: Claude Code through its dart MCP entry, DSH through dart-mcp-server and its ios_sim tools, and no-MCP through the CLI.
No tool name is invented: each one named for DSH exists in this workspace.
The original's closing note is updated: the file is no longer branch-only, so it now says where the setup lives.

Verification.Command: for s in SIGUSR1 SIGUSR2 'tools/list' 'mcp-server' 'plain path' '110' 'DailyRacesDisplay' 'kDailyRaceCardAspectRatio' 'Claude Code' 'dart-mcp-server'; do grep -q "$s" .agents/skills/flutter-run/SKILL.md || echo "MISSING: $s"; done

T-003.Title: Bring the live-app-inspection guidance into the current AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Both files carry a live-app-inspection section naming .mcp.json, the plain-path rule, the launch timings measured on this project, and the device boot steps.
The section is adapted to the rewritten files: it no longer points at openspec/config.yaml and it keeps the GRACE 4 protocol section intact.

Verification.Command: grep -q 'Live app inspection' AGENTS.md && grep -q 'Live app inspection' CLAUDE.md && diff -q AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md

T-004.Title: Confirm the skill is loadable and the change touched nothing else

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The skill sits in .agents/skills/flutter-run/ with a parseable frontmatter block whose name matches its directory.
git diff --name-only lists only the five declared paths, proving no application code moved.

Verification.Command: test "$(git status --porcelain -- lib test assets | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 0

T-005.Title: Delete the rescued branch locally and on origin

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The branch is deleted with `git branch -D chore/agent-config-and-theme` and `git push origin --delete chore/agent-config-and-theme`, so it is gone from the local repository and from origin.
The deletion happens only after the content is on main, which the dependency ordering enforces.
